name: jairf-quests
description: JAIRF quest & content framework roadmap (per 07_Quest_Content_Framework.md). Quest types: talk/kill/collect/reach/escort/craft/deliver/multi-stage/daily/world events/player-created. Data structure: ID, localized title/desc, giver, objectives, rewards, prerequisites, failure, flags. Dialogue: node-based/branching, conditions, voice hooks, emote triggers. World pillars: main story spine, regional side, exploration rewards, social/guild, builder showcases/housing, seasonal. Authoring: data-driven, feedback-rich, clear messaging, minimal backtracking, solo + group.

phases.name: 2. Dialogue system core (nodes, conditions, voice/emote hooks)
3. World content pillars (story, side, exploration, guild, builder, seasonal)
4. Authoring guidelines + agent rules (data-driven, messaging, pacing)
